scope: 4090 offline preview and read-only preflight; no hardware movement
limitations: Default dry-run previews around zero without reading live qpos. Current qpos limits were checked separately via ROS subscription; physical clearance not confirmed.
Return tolerance 0.01rad is larger than test amplitude 0.005rad. Return-to-start success does not by itself prove motion tracking or exact return.
CSV command/feedback call times do not measure physical command-to-response latency; sensor timestamps absent.
A send_arm_qpos exception before CSV write can lose buffered rows; terminal output must be preserved.
Execution enables/follower mode, sets persistent speed5%, and exceptions/Ctrl-C request electronic emergency stop. No controller state was changed in this review.
next_step: Explicitly confirm change from prior read-only scope and physical readiness before SDK execution. Stop existing ROS/CAN owner only after that confirmation; operator enters SINGLE_CAN and STREAM on site.
